markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 frozen section with 0% invasive risk [F1], clear margins [F7], and severity-3 stain degradation.

## Confidence
|Signal | Value | Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities | Normal 94%, Benign 5%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal call; 0% invasive|
|Conformal set | {Normal}, α=10% (90% dataset coverage) | Single class separated at 90%|
|Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 58th percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical input despite stain artifact|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent foundation models concur|
|Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (91–94%) [F5]; contrast Benign 88% | Unanimous Normal neighbor match|

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.13; contribution -0.465) pulls from invasive [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.22; contribution +0.305) nudges toward invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.11; contribution -0.23) pulls from invasive [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.29; contribution -0.133) pulls from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on frozen section masks Benign tissue like contrast case BACH_0384 (88% similarity).
- Elevated border scores (inferior 97%, medial 93%, lateral 84%) reflect margin involvement; cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 10**: Confirm normal two-layered lobules without mitoses; both concept scores are unreliable.
2. **Regions 8, 10, 11**: Check inferior (97%), medial (93%), lateral (84%) margins and region 8 stroma (risk 0.007).
3. **Regions 5, 6**: Verify ducts and tubules against Benign contrast case BACH_0384 (88% similarity).
